# The core services a module may import (docs/architecture/core-and-modules.md "Guards"): "<module id> <core package>",
# one module and one package a line, exactly (no wildcard, no prefix). Each is a known debt, not a precedent: a module
# reaches the core through internal/modapi, its seam and the contracts and leaf libraries, and a line here goes away when
# the core serves what the module needs through a port. TestModuleServicesAreUsed fails on a line no module needs any
# more, so the list only shrinks unless a reviewer adds a line. Never add internal/assistant, internal/hub or
# internal/extmgr.
#
# recording keeps the recordings' storage in the knowledge base (the kb.Recording model and its Engine and Store), which
# stays in the core until kb exposes a recording port (#13407).
recording internal/kb
